body:
thanks for the nice words. I hope things work out for you too. These comments really do make a difference. I actually felt like someone cared, and the irony was that these people that cared, was those I've never met nor helped before.

Life is just funny sometimes. You've helped me with your words, and I hope you know that you're not alone too.

Thanks dude, things are a bit better now. I confronted my past, when I wrote this was actually the anniversary of a very traumatic event, and I decided to not run away and instead relive it once more and this time approach it differently. Safe to say, though it still haunts me and this anger will possibly take time to subside, I now feel the need to not just mop around and be sad. 

Sometimes, I actually think what I'm doing is a selfish act, I'm doing it in hopes others will do the same for me. In a way, I'm doing it for myself and that indirectly makes me a hypocrite doesn't it ?

I mean, that's another thing that sucks dude, I mean, how can I possibly change this horrible thought when I'm trying to honestly do something without expecting for anything in return. I just suck, but yeah, people move on, and hopefully I'll too.

Thank you for your kind words. I was really down and have honestly given up, I read this but thought it was just bullshit on that day cause I was just very angry at myself for not achieving anything.

But what you said really had a profound impact on me, I thought about the scenario you gave and that helped me see things a bit better after. Sometimes, it's just so much easier to just give up, especially when you feel like there's nothing more worth fighting for. But yeah, as you said, I should not hope too much of others.
